newsitem.title: USA: Goldman prices $75 mln New York City Euronotes.
newsitem.headline: Goldman prices $75 mln New York City Euronotes.

text.p: Goldman Sachs & Co on Tuesday in London priced $75 million of New York City floating rate Euronotes, 24 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate, a city official said.

The notes are part of the city's capital borrowing plan for Tuesday. The city also sold $468 million of tax-exmept municipal bonds through J.P. Morgan Securities Inc, with a top yield of 5.575 percent in 2022.
This is the third offering of city floating rate Euronotes, the city official said. The last time the city sold the notes, it was 28 basis points over LIBOR, the official said.

The pricing level on Tuesday was attributed to good credit ratings, including the European credit agency's rating of single-A and positive review of city debt, the official said. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
